subject: Access evidence: least-privilege mapping & SCIM sync logs request
messages:
From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@pharmaco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@pharmaco.com
Date: 2027-02-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: least-privilege mapping + SCIM deltas for SOC2 evidence

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our SOC 2 scoping we're collecting artifact packages to confirm least-privilege enforcement across integrations. Can you help with the following items?

1) A role-to-permission mapping for the last full prod tenant (spreadsheet preferred).
2) SCIM delta/log extract covering provisioning events for the period 2026-12-01 to 2027-02-01 (CSV).
3) SAML assertion samples for a standard user and a service account.
4) Short write-up (1 page) describing how RBAC is enforced in the Private deployment and any delegation rules.

We'd like to receive everything by EOD 2027-02-22 so our audit team can include it in the evidence bundle. Please flag any items you can't provide or that require an NDA/DP Addendum.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Security Ops | Pharmaco Therapeutics
attachments: None (we'll accept links or zipped artifacts)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@pharmaco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: least-privilege mapping + SCIM deltas for SOC2 evidence

Alyssa —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the role mapping and SCIM delta export; Rishi will pull the logs and a spreadsheet. A few clarifying points before we run exports so we scope exactly what you need:

- For (1) is a tenant-scoped role_inventory workbook okay (roles sheet + permissions sheet + notes column for special cases)?
- For (2) SCIM delta: do you want just sync events (PATCH/PUT/create/delete) or the full audit (including API warnings and rate-limit events)? We typically pull the full event stream and filter to provisioning events.
- For (3) SAML samples: we can redact user PII but include assertion attributes and timestamps — is that acceptable?
- For (4) the 1-page write-up: we'll draft operational notes and include the RBAC enforcement points and any delegation (service accounts, delegated admins).

We're on track to meet your 2027-02-22 deadline; Rishi will target an initial package by 2027-02-19 so you can review earlier. If Pharmaco needs a signed DPA amendment for SCIM logs, flag and we'll route to Legal.

Jonas
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Jonas Weber

Alyssa / team —

Attached is our first pass. I'm including: role_inventory_20270218.xlsx (roles + permission enumerations + notes), scim_delta_20270218.csv (provisioning events filtered to PATCH/PUT/create/delete between 2026-12-01 and 2027-02-01), and a short text file with minpriv mapping notes.

Attachment stubs: role_inventory_20270218.xlsx (xlsx), scim_delta_20270218.csv (csv), minpriv_mapping_notes.txt (txt)

Key notes:
- We redacted direct user identifiers in the CSV but left stable internal IDs and timestamps to support traceability.
- Service-account assertions are sampled in the SAML folder (we've redacted live assertion signatures in the sample).
- For the RBAC write-up, Laura will add a paragraph on delegated admin flows for Dedicated clusters.

If this looks good, we'll upload a zipped evidence bundle to the secure Drive folder and add a short manifest.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Reliability Engineer, Infra

Subject: Re: Request: least-privilege mapping + SCIM deltas for SOC2 evidence

Thanks, Rishi — the artifacts look good on first pass. A few quick asks:

- Can you include the SAML assertion samples in the zip (we didn't see them in the Drive snapshot).
- Please add a short column to the role_inventory workbook naming the typical principal types (human, service_account, delegated_admin).
- For the scim CSV please confirm if the redaction removed external email addresses (we need proof of identifier redaction).

If you can post an updated zip by EOD we'll slot it for auditor review tomorrow. Also, we do require a signed DPA addendum for log delivery — can you route a DocuSign for that?

If you prefer, send the DocuSign link and I'll loop Legal on our side.

Best,
Alyssa
